introduce: Start with your feet together and your arms by your sides, then jump up with your feet apart and your hands overhead. \n\nReturn to the start position then do the next rep. This exercise provides a full-body workout and works all your large muscle groups.
name: JUMPING JACKS

tips.text: Bend your arms to bring your hands over your head.
Start at a slow speed, then gradually increase the pace.
Your arms shouldn't be straight when you raise them above your head.
Inhale when your feet are apart, and exhale when pulling them back.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your ankles.
If you feel it's too easy, jump as high as you can.
Your back, glutes, abs, shoulders and calves all get involved.
It's a full body exercise to strengthen your cardiovascular system.

introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under butt and your hands under shoulders. \n\nThen lift your right leg and squeeze your butt as much as you can. Go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.
name: DONKEY KICKS RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
To get better results, keep your core tight.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise tones your gluteus, and can also work on your hamstrings.

introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. \n\nThen lift your left leg and squeeze your butt as much as you can. Go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.
name: DONKEY KICKS LEFT

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
To get better results, keep your core tight.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise tones your gluteus, and can also work on your hamstrings.

introduce:
Lie on your back with arms at sides, palms down and legs extended. 

Lift your legs and cross the right thigh over the left, then reverse the exercise. 

Make sure your back is always flat.

It's a great exercise for the obliques and rectus abdominis.
name: SCISSORS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Slightly bend your knees.
Breathe naturally.
To make it easier, place your hands under your glutes to get more balance.
This exercise primarily targets your lower abs.
This exercise can help you get great balance.

introduce:
Stand on the floor, bend your legs slightly and lean your upper body forward. 

Then jump to the right. As you jump, bring your left foot behind you and your left arm in front of you. 

Then jump to the other side. Repeat the exercise.
name: SKATER JUMP

tips.text: Keep your back flat and your core tight.
Keep your shoulders back.
Don't lean your body forward too much.
Exhale when you jump, and inhale when you land.
You should feel your legs and butt burning.
This exercise can get your heart rate up.
This exercise is good for your cardiovascular system.
This exercise is great for your legs.

introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Then lift one leg up while raising your hips off the floor as high as you can. \n\nGo back to the start position and repeat the exercise.
name: HIP BRIDGE & LEG LIFT LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your spine straight when lifting your hips.
Tighten your abdominals.
Don't bend your lifted leg.
Exhale when lifting your hips, and inhale when lowering them.
If you feel it's too easy, don't make your hips touch the floor.
If you feel it's too hard, put both feet on the floor.
You shouldn't feel stress in your back, neck and shoulder area.
This exercise not only works on your glutes, but also your abs and hamstrings.

introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Then lift one leg up while raising your hips off the floor as high as you can. \n\nGo back to the start position and repeat with the other side.
name: HIP BRIDGE & LEG LIFT RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your spine straight when lifting your hips.
Tighten your abdominals.
Don't bend your lifted leg.
Exhale when lifting your hips, and inhale when lowering them.
If you feel it's too easy, don't make your hips touch the floor.
If you feel it's too hard, put both feet on the floor.
You shouldn't feel stress in your back, neck and shoulder area.
This not only works on your glutes, but also your abs and hamstrings.

introduce: Stand up on the floor, then run in place while kicking your heel up to touch your butt with each step.\n\nTry to do it as fast as you can. It\'s a great exercise for the gluteus and hamstrings.
name: BUTT KICKS

tips.text: Please keep your chest up.
Please try to get your feet to touch your hips.
Please pull your shoulders back.
Please tighten your abs.
Please land on your toes.
Please try to do it as fast as you can.
It’s a cardio exercise that can strengthen your gluteus and hamstrings.

introduce:
Stand on the floor, then bend your left leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your left calf close to your left thigh. 

Hold this position for a few seconds, then change sides and repeat.

Your lifted knee should always go straight down, and your upper body should keep straight during the exercise.
name: QUAD STRETCH

tips.text: Please keep your chest open.
The knee of your lifted leg should always point straight toward the ground.
Please keep your upper body straight.
This exercise works on your quadriceps.

introduce:
Start in a push-up position. Bring your left knee forward and drop your right knee on the floor. 

Raise your upper body and put your hands on your waist. Then push your hips forward while keeping your upper body straight. 

Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your upper body straight when pushing your hips forward.
Please do not arch your back.
Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes.
This exercise works on your hip flexors and thighs.

introduce:
Start in a push-up position. Bring your right knee forward and drop your left knee on the floor. 

Raise your upper body and put your hands on your waist. Then push your hips forward while keeping your upper body straight. 

Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your upper body straight when pushing your hips forward.
Please do not arch your back.
Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes.
This exercise works on your hip flexors and thighs.

introduce: Start in the straight arm plank position with your hands under your shoulders and feet together.\n\nHop your feet apart and land on your toes, then hop back. Repeat the exercise.
name: PLANK JACKS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your upper body stable.
Your body should be in a straight line.
Don't sink or raise your hips.
It is a good exercise for your abs, core, shoulders, and lower back.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your left ankle on your right knee.

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your right knee, and grab the back of your right thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, soften your hips, deepening the stretch.
name: GLUTE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your right ankle on your left knee.

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your left knee, and grab the back of your left thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, soften your hips, deepening the stretch.
name: GLUTE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Start in the classic squat position. 

Jump up, putting one foot forward and the other foot backward, then jump and switch legs. 

Jump again to come back to the squat position, and repeat the exercise.
name: FLUTTER KICK SQUATS

tips.text: Please keep your core tight.
Push the toes of your back foot to jump, and gently land on the heel of your front foot.
This exercise works your quadriceps, glutes and hamstrings.
This exercise not only strengthens your lower body but also burns lots of calories in a short time.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Bend your arms in front of you to keep balance. \n\nLower your body until your thighs are parallel with the floor. Come half way up instead of coming all the way up, then squat down again. Repeat.
name: SQUAT PULSES

tips.text: Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes.
Squeeze your gluteus.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
You should feel your glutes really on fire.
Please keep your back straight.

introduce:
Start with your feet together and hands raised above your head. 

Jump up, spread your feet apart, lower your hands and squat down. 

Jump back to the start position and do the next rep.
name: SQUAT JACKS

tips.text: Inhale as you squat down, and exhale as you go up.
This exercise works all your large muscle groups and especially your gluteus.
